completion_reason: Three material architecture and integration boundaries remain unresolved.

questions.label: Provider contract
questions.context: Direct, LAN mesh, and PeerJS providers need one predictable integration boundary.
questions.question: What contract should every provider implement?

choices.text: One normalized invoke, health, cancel, and result contract
Separate contracts for each provider transport
A minimal invoke contract with optional capabilities

questions.label: Context handoff
questions.context: Conversation memory and workflow execution memory must remain isolated.
questions.question: How should Work context enter a workflow run?

choices.text: Copy an immutable versioned snapshot into the run
Pass only an operator-selected message subset

questions.label: Evidence storage
questions.context: NexusCentral must preserve crash-safe immutable run evidence and artifacts.
questions.question: What should be the canonical run evidence store?

choices.text: Transactional metadata plus content-addressed artifact files
Filesystem manifests and artifact folders only
All metadata and artifacts stored as database blobs
An external artifact service as the source of truth
